seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [target] show mixed outcomes: pixels,y x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Parse frame into 21x21 blocks: axis row (ring 10, dot 0 if selected), targets (solid 11), pieces (ring 5, centre 0 if selected); touching pieces split by 0-centre blocks.
Step: A1/A2 move selected axis (A3/A4 no-op when axis selected); selected piece moves A1-4, blocked by board edge and other pieces; A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc.
Render: reflections = piece blocks off the axis mirrored to row 2a-r, clipped, not on piece blocks; ring piece>refl>target>wall; centre 11 if target else first non-negative fill else bg 9.
HUD column 63: one 11->12 from the top per effective action; no-op actions do not tick (explains reflection A3 mixed outcome = selection state).
Unconfirmed: piece moving onto the axis row (allowed, its on-axis blocks do not reflect); A6/A7 treated as no-ops. Stateless 29/29 as well.
